result.reasoning: The query molecule CCc1cncc(NCc2cccnc2)n1 is a 2-ethyl-4-((pyridin-3-ylmethyl)amino)pyrimidine. While the pyrimidine core (6-membered ring with 2 nitrogen atoms) could potentially match the X1-X4 ring requirement (one or two of X1-X4 is N), the linker -NH-CH2- connecting the pyrimidine to the pyridine does not fit within the defined L1 or L2 options. L2 is defined as 'a covalent bond, -O-, -N(R)-, -N(R)C(O)-, and -N(R)S(O)2-'. The -N(R)- portion matches -NH-, but the intervening -CH2- (methylene) before the pyridine is not accounted for in any linker definition. R2 is defined as -R where R includes 'a 5- to 6-membered heteroaryl ring,' but the methylene bridge is not part of the heteroaryl ring itself and cannot be reasonably interpreted as an optional substitution on the pyridine connecting back to the core. Without clear confirmation from the Formula I image that this structural arrangement is encompassed, the molecule does not appear to fall within the claim scope.
